## About
Ducks Roofing is a roofing contractor on Janice Dr in Kennesaw. We know how important and valuable your home is to you, so we listen to what you need, do a thorough and accurate roof inspection, and make the repairs at a fair and affordable price.
When storms and high winds damage your home, we work directly with your claims adjuster so the job gets done right the first time. And it doesn't stop at the roof. We also handle gutters, siding, fascia and soffit, painting, windows and doors.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 27 Google reviews, and some of them have called us back more than once.

## Services
- Residential & Commercial Roofs: Roofing for houses and commercial buildings.
- New Roofs & Roof Replacement: A new roof or a full replacement of the old one.
- Shingle, Tile, Metal & Flat Roofs: We work on shingle, tile, metal and flat roofs.
- Leak Repairs: Finding where the water is getting in and fixing it.
- 24-Hour Emergency Tarp & Repair: When damage can't wait, we tarp the roof and get the repair started.
- Hail & Storm Damage Repair: Repairs after hail, storms and high winds.
- Roof Inspection: A thorough, accurate look at your roof so you know what it needs.
- Insurance Claim Assistance: Help with your claim, working directly with your adjuster.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to schedule your free estimate, or send a request through the contact form.

Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We are storm damage and insurance claim specialists and will work directly with your claims adjuster.

Q: Do you do work besides roofing?
A: Yes. We also do gutters, gutter guards, siding, fascia and soffit, drywall, interior and exterior painting, windows and doors, and weatherproofing and insulation.

Q: Do you offer any special pricing?
A: We offer special pricing to seniors, veterans, police officers and firefighters. Ask about our current special offers.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
